summary: SafeLine là firewall WAF self-hosted và reverse proxy, bảo vệ ứng dụng web khỏi tấn công và khai thác lỗ hổng.
usecases: Protecting public-facing web applications from SQL injection and XSS attacks.
Providing a customizable security layer for self-hosted services and APIs.
Acting as a reverse proxy with security rules for internal network exposure.
ideas: Integrate with SIEM for centralized threat monitoring and alerting.
Combine with API gateway for unified request validation and routing.
Deploy as edge security for distributed web services.
